TMPD=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ca-postreboot.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMPD"; rm -f /usr/share/ca-certificates/local/os-comparison-root-ca.srl' EXIT HUP INT TERM
umask 077
openssl genrsa -out "$TMPD/leaf.key" 1024 >/dev/null 2>&1
openssl req -new -key "$TMPD/leaf.key" -out "$TMPD/leaf.csr" -subj '/CN=post-reboot-trust-probe' >/dev/null 2>&1
openssl x509 -req -in "$TMPD/leaf.csr" -CA "$CERT" -CAkey "$KEY" -CAcreateserial -out "$TMPD/leaf.crt" -days 1 -sha256 >/dev/null 2>&1
printf 'POST_BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'OS='; sed -n 's/^DISTRIB_DESCRIPTION=//p' /etc/lsb-release
printf 'KERNEL='; uname -r
printf 'PACKAGES\n'; dpkg-query -W -f='${Package} ${Version} ${Status}\n' openssl ca-certificates
printf 'PERSISTED_CA\n'; openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -subject -issuer -fingerprint -sha1
openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -text | sed -n '/X509v3 Basic Constraints/,+1p'
printf 'TRUST_REGISTRATION\n'; grep -Fx 'local/os-comparison-root-ca.crt' /etc/ca-certificates.conf
ls -l /etc/ssl/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.pem /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
printf 'POST_REBOOT_EXPLICIT_BUNDLE_VERIFY\n'; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt "$TMPD/leaf.crt"
printf 'POST_REBOOT_DEFAULT_VERIFY\n'; openssl verify "$TMPD/leaf.crt"
CERT_MOD=$(openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -modulus | openssl md5)
KEY_MOD=$(openssl rsa -in "$KEY" -noout -modulus 2>/dev/null | openssl md5)
[ "$CERT_MOD" = "$KEY_MOD" ] && printf 'KEY_CERT_MATCH=yes\n'
printf 'KEY_MODE='; stat -c '%a %U:%G' "$KEY"
printf 'NODE_HEALTH network='; ip -o -4 addr show scope global | sed -n '1s/^[^ ]* [^ ]* *//p'
printf 'NODE_HEALTH sshd_processes='; pgrep -c sshd || true
